title.narrative: Greater Mekong Subregion Southern Economic Corridor Towns Development Project

description.narrative: The project will enhance the competitiveness of towns along the Southern Economic Corridor (SEC). The project will transform the corridor towns of Battambang, Bavet, Neak Loeung, and Poipet in Cambodia into economic hubs by improving urban-environmental infrastructure and strengthening institutional capacities of provincial and local authorities. The productivity of economic enterprises in these towns will be significantly improved since there will be increased climate resilience through flood control measures. The environment will be improved through clean wastewater, disposal of solid waste, and enhanced mobility on improved urban roads. The project will provide environmental infrastructure for wastewater treatment and solid waste management, which will, among others, help to reduce the carbon footprint of these towns, making them cleaner and greener, and more livable. The project will finance 8 subprojects in these towns based on Mid-Term Review Mission in November 2018.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. SLEDP adopted and implemented in Battambang, Bavet, Neak Loeung, and Poipet Indicator: Gender awareness and sensitization training for 30 EAs/IAs staff conducted Progress/Status: Target has been achieved/overachieved.
21 women (70% of target) from staff of the Project Management Unit and Project Implementation Units have received training on Gender Awareness and Sensitization and other related training as well. Data Source: Local development plans of IAs and corridor towns Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: 30% of construction workers to be hired under the Project are female Progress/Status: There have been over 32% of female workers hired by the project contractors for construction works.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Quarterly and annual progress reports of IAs Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Battambang: 1. Storm drainage (PPCR) - 33,000 residents serviced by new and rehabilitated storm drainage. Flood events of facility reduced (based on 50 year flood frequency) Progress/Status: Constructions and defect liability period were completed. The city areas which used to get flooded before the construction of these drainage networks are now no longer flooded.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Local authorities' statistical data Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Battambang: 3. Materials Recovery Facility - 30 cubic meters of recyclables per day segregated benefiting 128,000 residents Progress/Status: Constructions and the defect liability period were completed. Transferring ownership of MRF to Battambang municipality was completed as well.
Battambang Municipality has engaged a private operator for daily operations and maintenance. This facility is running well and selected by DOCK to showcase project success story.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Quarterly and annual progress reports of IAs Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Bavet 5: Urban roads - 6.31 km of main urban road upgraded with drainage structures, benefiting 37,100 residents Progress/Status: Constructions and the defect liability period were completed. The upgraded urban road section creates economic benefits for local residents and significantly reduces traffic jams.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Quarterly and annual progress reports of IAs Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Bavet: 4. Storm Drainage (PPCR)- 29,000 residents serviced by storm drainage; flood events of facility reduced based on 50-year flood frequency Progress/Status: Constructions and defect liability period were completed. The city areas which used to get flooded before the construction of these drainage networks are now no longer flooded.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Quarterly and annual progress reports of IAs Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Bavet: 6. MRF - 30 cubic meters of recyclables per day segregated, benefiting 24,000 residents Progress/Status: Constructions and the defect liability period were completed. Transferring ownership of MRF to Bavet Municipality was completed as well. Bavet Municipality has failed to transfer to a private operator for daily operations and maintenance.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Quarterly and annual progress reports of IAs Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Neak Loeung: 7. Flood Protection (PPCR) - 4.29 km flood protection dike constructed; 363 ha of residential and commercial areas protected from annual flooding (based on 50 year flood frequency), benefiting 24,700 residents Progress/Status: A final review mission was undertaken to confirm the completion of the flood dyke. The mission confirms all activity has been completed and operational.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Quarterly and annual progress reports of IAs Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Poipet: 10. MRF - 30 cubic meters of recyclables from dry sources segregated, benefiting 58,600 Progress/Status: Constructions and the defect liability period were completed. Transferring ownership of MRF to Poipet Municipality was done. Poipet Municipality has failed to transfer to a private operator for daily operations and maintenance.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Quarterly and annual progress reports of IAs Actual value:

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Poipet: 8. Storm Drainage (PPCR)- 65,000 residents serviced by storm drainage. Flood events of facility reduced (based on 50 year flood frequency) Progress/Status: Constructions and defect liability period were completed. The city areas used to get flooded before the construction of this drainage network is now no longer flooded.
Other details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Quarterly and annual progress reports of IAs Actual value:

Output: 3. Institutional capacities strengthened Indicator: By 2021: 1,000 people trained in project management and implementation, and social and environment safeguards; gender targets achieved: Staff quota of 30% female in PMU and PIU, increased role in decision making Progress/Status: Various capacity building training courses have been conducted for PMU and PIUs, of which 471 PMU and PIUs staff trained and 89 (19%) are women.
Training courses on Social and Environmental Safeguard and Sanitation and Hygiene Promotion for the three project towns have been conducted of which 1,062 participants trained and 650 are women.
Training courses on Concrete Works and Painting Skills, Solid Waste Recycling and Existing Business in Battambang, Bavet and Poipet have been conducted of which 516 participants trained and 399 are women.
Road Safety and HIV awareness campaigns have been conducted in Battambang, Bavet and Poipet of which 6,102 participants attended and 5,407 (89%) are women. Data Source: EA and IA records of capacity building and training events (disaggregated by sex); Numbers of staff (by gender) before and after project implementation
Actual value:

Output: 3. Institutional capacities strengthened Indicator: Women hold 30% of overall staff positions and 30% of the management positions in the PMU and PIU Progress/Status: Out of a total 10 PMU staff, 3 staff (30%) are women.
Out of a total 35 PIUs staff, 11 staffs (31%) are women. Data Source: EA/IAs Actual value:

Output: 1. SLEDP adopted and implemented in Battambang, Bavet, Neak Loeung, and Poipet Indicator: By 2021: SLEDPs with sex specific and climate resilience measures incorporated, adopted and disclosed, updated as required. [Baseline: 2010 no such Development Plans available] Progress/Status: Target has been achieved.
The preliminary strategic local and economic development plans (SLEDPs) for Battambang, Bavet, Neak Loeung, and Poipet towns were adopted by the provincial authorities in February 2017 and have been updated to reflect the recent planning and development. ADB approved and disclosed these updated SLEDPs on its website in December 2023. Data Source: Local development plans of IAs and corridor towns Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2010 Baseline value: N Target year: 2023 Target value: Y

Output: 2. Priority urban infrastructure investments implemented Indicator: Priority infrastructure operational by 2021 Progress/Status: All eight urban infrastructures have been completed and operational.
Urban infrastructure affects are likely to be achieved or overachieved, but details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Subproject completion reports of IAs Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2011 Baseline value: N Target year: 2023 Target value: Y

Output: 3. Institutional capacities strengthened Indicator: MOA signed between IAs and District/Corridor town authorities on subproject O&M and climate resilience measures Progress/Status: These storm drainage and road rehabilitation subprojects were handed over to respective sub-national authorities for daily operations and maintenance.
For MRF in Battambang, both hand-over contract/MOU to local authority and to private operator for daily operations and maintenance was completed.
For MEFs in Bavet and Poipet, hand-over contract/MOU to local authority was completed but from the local authority has failed to transfer to a private operator for O&M. Data Source: Community level capacity building for increased gender awareness and participation of women in local decision-making Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2013 Baseline value: N Target year: 2023 Target value: Y
Urban infrastructure improved and climate resilience enhanced in Battambang, Bavet, Neak Loeung, and Poipet

Between 2013- 2023: Improved access to urban infrastructure affects 558,220 inhabitants (cumulative figure) in four project towns Progress/Status: All eight urban infrastructures have been completed and operational.
Urban infrastructure affects are likely to be achieved or overachieved, but details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Provincial and district/town statistics Actual value:

Urban areas affected by perennial flooding reduced by 30% Progress/Status: Completed Storm Drainage Subprojects in Bavet, Poipet and Battambang and newly completed Flood Control Dyke in Neak Loeung are playing the important role to protect and reduce flood in these towns.
Benefits to targeted beneficiaries are likely to be achieved or overachieved, but details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Provincial and district/town statistics Actual value:

Annual economic impact of poor sanitation, accounting to a loss of $33 in 2005 per capita per year, reduced by 40% Progress/Status: Likely to be achieved. Details will be assessed and confirmed during the project completion review mission. Data Source: Provincial and district/town statistics Actual value:
